tagline.ru: Цифровая стоматология в Нариманове с 2003 года

intro.az: Dental Club 2003-cü ildən fəaliyyət göstərir: rəqəmsal implantasiya və breketsiz ortodontiya. Onlayn yazılın — administrator vaxtı təsdiqləmək üçün sizinlə əlaqə saxlayacaq.
intro.ru: Dental Club работает с 2003 года: цифровая имплантация и ортодонтия без брекетов. Запишитесь онлайн — администратор свяжется с вами, чтобы подтвердить время.
intro.en: Dental Club has been practising since 2003, with digital implant planning and brace-free orthodontics. Book online and our administrator will contact you to confirm the time.

address.az: Ceyhunbəy Hacıbəyli küç. 24, Nərimanov r-nu, Bakı
address.ru: ул. Джейхунбека Гаджибейли, 24, Наримановский р-н, Баку

items.author: Heydar I.
items.text: The doctors are very polite. Prices are affordable. The main thing, they are using high tech while repairing teeth. Sterilization is in high level

items.author: Sevda A.
items.text: Very nice dental clinic with professional dentists. Teamwork approach especially Oral surgeon Dr Rovshan Mammadov.

items.author: Shonna G.
items.text: They were incredible! I walked in without an appointment and they were so gracious and professional when working me into the schedule. The doctors were very polite and efficient. My teeth were sparkling by the time I left. The prices were much more affordable than what was available in the US. I highly recommend!

text.az: 20 ildən artıqdır ki, Bakıda pasiyent qəbul edir.
text.ru: Принимает пациентов в Баку более 20 лет.
text.en: Treating patients in Baku for over 20 years.

text.ru: Имплантация планируется с помощью цифровых хирургических шаблонов.
text.en: Implants are planned with digital surgical guides.

text.az: Klinikanın saytına görə həkimlər EDAD-Baku üzvüdür.
text.ru: По данным сайта клиники, врачи — члены EDAD-Baku.
text.en: According to the clinic's website, its dentists are EDAD-Baku members.

text.az: Bir dəqiqəyə onlayn yazılın və qəbuldan bir gün əvvəl WhatsApp-da xatırlatma alın.
text.ru: Запишитесь онлайн за минуту и получите напоминание в WhatsApp за день до приёма.
text.en: Book online in a minute and get a WhatsApp reminder the day before your visit.

address.note: Shown: Ceyhunbəy Hacıbəyli 24, as on the clinic's Google Maps listing (seen 2026-10-21) and some directories. 2GIS says 116b (1st floor), others 114; the site's contact page reportedly shows 'Bakıxanov küç. 758/759'. Confirm.

phones.note: Landline appears on the site and in directories. Directories also list +994 70 379-28-40 and +994 50 344-88-74 (not shown).

whatsapp.note: The third-party audit found no WhatsApp link on the site; 2GIS shows a WhatsApp button but no number was visible.

instagram.note: The site links to Instagram but the handle was not found.

website.note: Site exists; per the third-party audit the online-booking button is disabled and only a static contact form remains. Not re-tested (direct page loads blocked).

hours.note: Site: Monday to Saturday 10:00–18:00 (shown). 2GIS: until 20:00 on at least one day. Sunday not stated.

services.note: Digital implants, surgical guides and aligners from the clinic's own site; braces from an old FED.az article.

prices.note: An old FED.az article lists braces at 1800–4000 AZN; not shown because it is outdated.

doctors.note: Dr Rovshan Mammadov (oral surgeon) is named in a Google review from about 6 months ago; spelling as in the review. Other names not found; confirm on the call.

rating.note: Google 4.7 from 31 reviews on the clinic's Google Maps listing (seen 2026-10-21). A third-party site reported 4.7 from 29 on 2026-09-29.

founded.note: Since 2003, per the clinic's own website.

map.note: Google Maps search query built from the address; no verified Google Maps place link found.

brandColor.note: Neutral colour chosen by us; the clinic logo was not used.

photos.note: Neutral illustrations only; no clinic photos or logos copied.

reviews.note: 3 reviews copied word for word (original English) from the clinic's Google Maps listing on 2026-10-21; names shortened to first name + surname initial. Relative dates as of that day. For the demo only; switch to the live Google feed or get the clinic's OK before going public.
